name: Ajit Doval
portrayed_by: Continues as 'Ajay Sanyal' (R. Madhavan) or new actor
real_life_parallel: National Security Advisor (2014-present); architect of Modi-Doval doctrine

biography.background: National Security Advisor throughout 2014-2025. Architect of 'Modi-Doval doctrine' — shift to proactive/punitive counter-terrorism. Coordinated surgical strikes, Balakot, Sindoor. Bridge between political leadership and operational agencies.
biography.doctrine: Defensive offense; proactive defense; punitive deterrence
biography.evolution_from_film_2: From IB Director (2004-05) to NSA with expanded mandate
biography.film_relevance: Parts 3-4: Central strategist; operational coordinator; doctrine articulator
